records.objective: Magnetic attach to shoulder (0-5s), guardian shifts and Rain holds on (5-10s), guardian shrugs hard and throws her off, she catches her board mid-air (10-15s).
spatial_relations: Lighting: cold pale ambient from above, saturated red from guardian's eye-sockets, saturated purple from hoverboard thrusters, saturated blue-violet from Rain's magnetic palms, warm amber oil-lamps.
Rain riding the board, body angled forward, right hand extended palm-open with saturated BLUE-VIOLET MAGNETIC FIELD pulsing from her palm — a glowing field of cold blue-violet energy.
She closes the distance to the guardian's massive carved stone SHOULDER in shallow blurred background, the carved relief of the shoulder armor and its ornate ancient script visible.

As she gets close, the magnetic field from her palm INTENSIFIES, pulling her hand toward the stone shoulder, then her hand SLAPS onto the carved stone surface — the magnetic adhesion locking her to the colossal armor with a deep humming snap.

Then in real time the colossus performs a deliberate SHRUG — the massive shoulder ROLLING and JERKING under her with sudden force, the carved stone surface pitching her body away from her grip, her magnetic palm strained against the stone.
The shrug is too violent — her hand RIPS free from the magnetic adhesion (a saturated blue-violet flash of broken field), her body THROWN through the air away from the shoulder.

records.objective: Handheld long-lens medium shot of a young man running through an ancient corridor and suddenly hearing a scream from behind, 3 seconds.
spatial_relations: Handheld long-lens medium shot of a young man running through an ancient corridor and suddenly hearing a scream from behind, 3 seconds.

In the deep background of the corridor, far ahead at its end, a distant carved stone gateway with cold blue light spilling through from beyond it — but a massive carved stone slab is visibly descending slowly from the ceiling above this gateway, having descended about halfway, the gap below the slab still tall but visibly shrinking.
CHARACTER: a young man, mid-twenties, with dark messy shoulder-length hair, light mustache, a red bandage strip across the bridge of his nose, dark jacket, dust-covered face.
He is in mid-run, body in full sprint motion, breath ragged, focus locked ahead toward the distant gateway.
He is running away from camera direction (forward through the corridor toward the gateway).
Suddenly he HEARS something — a distant scream of his name from off-frame far behind him in the corridor (the sound is heard by the audience as well: a faint cracking "ROCO!
His head WHIPS back sharply over his shoulder toward the source of the scream behind him.
His face shows brutal conflict in a single second — eyes wide, jaw tight, the pull between forward duty and what's behind him visible across his expression.
He keeps moving forward but slower now, his focus split between ahead and behind, body in the moment of decision.

" scream echoing from far behind with deep stone reverb, the running stride hesitating with audible pause and disruption in the footstep rhythm, sharp inhale of internal conflict, deep slow grinding stone-on-stone rumble from the distant slab descending, torches crackling on the walls.
